purpose: Extra-global discovery registry for religious and Islamic book sources. Discovery does not imply redistribution permission; every title/edition/asset is rights-gated before ingestion.

sources.name: OpenITI Corpus
sources.scope: Arabic and Persian Islamicate texts; expanding to Ottoman Turkish and Urdu
sources.value: Machine-actionable scholarly corpus with provenance-oriented metadata and standards-based text representations.
sources.redistribution: verify per corpus release and source edition

sources.name: KITAB
sources.scope: Arabic texts, text reuse, Arabic book history
sources.value: Curated corpus and metadata for Arabic book history and text reuse research.

sources.name: Al-Maktaba al-Waqfeya
sources.scope: Arabic Islamic books, scanned editions, metadata and browsing by author/section/century
sources.value: Large discovery source for scanned religious books and scholarly editions; useful as a discovery and verification layer.

sources.name: Maktabat Sayd al-Fawaid
sources.scope: Quran and tafsir, hadith, fiqh, aqidah, seerah, biographies, Arabic and foreign-language Islamic books
sources.value: Current catalog exposes thousands of titles across major Islamic disciplines.

sources.name: IslamWeb Islamic Library
sources.scope: Hadith, tafsir, Quran sciences, fiqh, usul, aqidah, seerah, biographies, fatwas and more
sources.value: Large structured catalog with subject and book lists and many PDF records.
sources.redistribution: verify publisher/edition rights; site availability does not itself grant redistribution

sources.name: Alukah Library
sources.scope: Readable, audio, visual and Islamic books; current scholarly additions
sources.value: Current active library with books, PDFs and audio resources; useful for discovery and source comparison.

sources.name: Alwaraq Heritage Library
sources.scope: Classical Arabic works including tafsir, hadith, biographies, history, language and Islamic culture
sources.value: Large heritage catalog including works such as Tafsir al-Qurtubi, Ihya Ulum al-Din and Tadhkirat al-Huffaz-related materials.
sources.redistribution: verify site and digitized-edition terms for every work

sources.name: Princeton Manuscripts of the Islamic World
sources.scope: Predominantly Arabic manuscripts plus Persian and Ottoman Turkish; Islamic law, Quranic sciences, seerah and related works
sources.value: 3,453 items in the curated collection, with many item-level scans and rights metadata; includes Yemeni manuscript digitization work.
sources.redistribution: item-level rights must be checked; collection includes No Known Copyright and also contractual restrictions

sources.name: Library of Congress Arabic Manuscripts / St. Catherine's collections
sources.scope: Arabic manuscripts including religious materials and Prophet-related documents
sources.value: Provides high-value scans plus item-level rights/access metadata and IIIF manifests where available.
sources.redistribution: check each item rights field; some items are explicitly public domain

sources.name: Tanzil Quran Text
sources.scope: Verified Quran text in multiple formats
sources.value: Explicit terms allow verbatim copying/distribution in websites/apps with attribution, while changing the text is prohibited and updates should be tracked.
sources.redistribution: CC BY 3.0 with source-specific no-change condition

sources.name: Quranic Arabic Corpus
sources.scope: Morphology, syntax, ontology and Quranic linguistic annotation
sources.value: Useful enrichment layer for morphology and linguistic analysis; its data license and attribution/no-change terms must be preserved.
sources.redistribution: GNU public license plus source-specific no-change/attribution terms

sources.name: Sunnah.com
sources.scope: Hadith collections, translations, grading and API
sources.value: Important reference and API source, but current terms explicitly prohibit scraping and mass reproduction of entire books/collections.
sources.redistribution: do_not_scrape_or_mass_reproduce; request API/offline access from maintainers when available

sources.name: Sanadset
sources.scope: 650k+ hadith-chain records from 926 historical Arabic hadith books
sources.value: Strong research resource for isnad/narrator modeling and hadith-structure analysis.
sources.redistribution: verify original-source rights before incorporation into a production corpus

sources.name: LK-Hadith-Corpus
sources.scope: 39,038 annotated hadiths from six canonical hadith books with Arabic-English alignment
sources.value: Useful benchmark and bilingual retrieval/translation resource.
sources.redistribution: verify repository license and underlying text rights

sources.name: NAH-Hadith-Corpus
sources.scope: 452,624 words from lesser-known hadith books with isnad/matan/comment annotations
sources.value: Useful for negative-class and isnad/matan/comment boundary research; not a theological endorsement of included claims.
sources.redistribution: verify dataset and source-book rights before production use

sources.name: ArabicNLPWorld Canonical Islamic Corpus
sources.scope: Quran verses plus curated hadith matns
sources.value: Useful contemporary benchmark/reference corpus for hallucination detection and canonical-text retrieval.
sources.redistribution: verify dataset card and upstream rights before redistribution

sources.name: Fiqh Corpus (Arabic Digital Humanities)
sources.scope: Arabic jurisprudence texts ca. 800-1950 across legal-school subcorpora
sources.value: Large research corpus with approximately 49.3 million tokens; particularly important for comparative fiqh and Maghreb/Maliki research.
sources.redistribution: verify underlying Shamela/source terms and each subcorpus before production ingestion

sources.name: Tashkeela
sources.scope: 75M+ fully vocalized words, mainly classical Arabic texts from Islamic books
sources.value: Important for Arabic diacritization, pronunciation, search normalization and TTS preparation.
sources.redistribution: verify current data license and source-book rights before bundling
